# Recipes · Συνταγές · Recettes

Bilingual recipes at <https://petmakris.github.io/recipes/>. Source code and
outcomes live together, the frequence way, but with sources tucked away.

**Hard rule: every piece of user-facing text is in both Greek and French,
side by side.** No exceptions.

## Layout

```
index.html            the hub — lists all recipes
assets/style.css      one shared theme for every recipe page
<slug>/
  index.html          the recipe page (hand-written HTML, no build step)
  *.pdf               printable PDF(s), generated by the source project
  src/                the generator project (build.py etc.), committed as-is
```

## Adding a recipe

1. Drop the generator project (the `syrup-doc`-style repo with its `build.py`,
   fonts, `CLAUDE.md`) into `<slug>/src/` and its generated PDF into `<slug>/`.
2. Write `<slug>/index.html` by hand: content comes from the Python lists in
   `src/build.py`, French translation written alongside the Greek, linking
   `../assets/style.css`. Mobile first — these pages are read in a kitchen or
   a supermarket.
3. French words the reader will physically see on packaging or aisle signs get
   `class="fr"` (teal). Merely-translated words don't — see the teal rule in
   `syrup/src/CLAUDE.md`.
4. Add a card to `index.html` here and a row to the repo root `README.md`.
